decisions.reason: Featured on the home page, the transactional email service is a strategic growth offering that fits the firm's cloud messaging core.
It has its own dedicated page and complements the document and fax processing business, so the firm likely sees it as a meaningful line.
Email-to-fax conversion is closely tied to the firm's established communication services and costs little to maintain.
As a feature of the existing fax service it has low standalone cost, so dropping it within a year is unlikely even though fax is declining.
Sandbox threat protection is a growing security need that strengthens the email security portfolio.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a standard part of an email security bundle and is cheap to keep running.
